entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return something.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
It's Sarah Miller. Order 8-6-7-5-3-0-9.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order here for the Velo Carbon Pro cycling shoes, delivered on December 31st. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit.
I'm sorry to hear that. Is it a sizing issue, or is there a technical fault causing discomfort?
They just hurt. I tried them on one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. I couldn't even get the cleats adjusted properly. I just want a refund.
Of course. Getting blisters from a new pair of shoes is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return policy for you... one moment.
Fine.
Okay, thanks for your patience, Sarah. I see here that your item is well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Whatever. How do I do it?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on your account. You can just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
So I have to go find a printer and a post office because your product was bad. Great.

I do apologize for the inconvenience, Sarah. I see you're one of our VIP members, and I want to make this right for you. For the trouble of having to return these, I've added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for a future purchase. Does that help at all?
I guess. It's the least you could do.
We appreciate your understanding. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience next time. Have a good day.
